title: Verified bipartite two-coloring
prompt: Using the bundled graph_paths reference domain, formalize and prove that the directed four-cycle with vertices a, b, c, d and arcs a->b, b->c, c->d, d->a is bipartite when interpreted through the underlying undirected graph. Validate and evaluate the candidate, search for a SUPPORTS_CLAIM witness, and independently verify the complete two-coloring with the compatible authorized checker.
